settings.title: Set up your Soliseed grow light with confidence.
settings.content: Use placement, distance, timer, and adjustment basics to make your grow light fit the spot where your plants live.

settings.title: Choose the placement
settings.content: Start from the plant's real spot: desk, shelf, corner, kitchen, living room, or greenhouse. Pick a setup form that can stay stable there.

settings.title: Set a practical distance
settings.content: Place the light close enough to support the plant, while leaving room for leaves to grow and for daily care.

settings.title: Use the timer
settings.content: Keep lighting consistent with a simple timer routine. Adjust timing based on your room, plant response, and season.

settings.title: Adjust as plants grow
settings.content: Check leaf distance, direction, and coverage regularly. Reposition the light when the plant gets taller or the setup changes.

settings.title: Placement, distance, timer, adjustment.
settings.content: These basics help make Soliseed grow lights easier to use in everyday indoor spaces.

settings.title: Still choosing the right setup?
settings.content: Use Find My Setup to match the light form to your growing spot.
